A Distinctive Four-Bedroom Detached Residence in an Exclusive Boutique Development.

Welcome to 14 Rockville Avenue.

An exceptional opportunity awaits at 14 Rockville Avenue, an immaculately presented, A2-rated detached family residence occupying one of the finest positions within this exclusive development of just 45 luxury homes.

Constructed in 2019 and extending to approximately 168 sq. m. / 1,880 sq. ft., this elegant double-fronted home has been thoughtfully designed to maximise natural light, generous proportions and modern family living across three beautifully appointed floors.

Positioned on a prime corner site within a quiet private cul-de-sac, the property enjoys an exceptionally large, wrap-around, south-facing rear garden that has been professionally landscaped to create a truly impressive outdoor living space.

With its luxurious interiors, premium finishes, additional attic storage, approved planning permission for a substantial side extension and access to a private residents’ walled garden dating back to the 18th century, this outstanding home offers a rare opportunity for discerning purchasers seeking a turn-key family residence in one of South Dublin’s most desirable locations.

OUTSIDE

Outstanding Outdoor Living.

The gardens at 14 Rockville Avenue are among the property’s most impressive features.
The extra-large wrap-around rear and side gardens have been meticulously landscaped to create a private and highly functional outdoor environment.
A broad patio area provides the perfect setting for al fresco dining, while the feature pergola creates an inviting space for entertaining family and friends throughout the year.
The Steeltech all-weather shed and the charming garden playhouse are both included in the sale, further enhancing the appeal of this exceptional outdoor space.
The rear garden is enclosed by full-height block walls, ensuring excellent privacy, while natural stone boundary walls define the attractive communal areas to the front of the property.

Development Potential
Adding even greater appeal, the property benefits from full planning permission for a substantial 52 sq. m. double-height side extension.
This presents an outstanding opportunity for future expansion while protecting the existing architectural integrity of the home.

An Exceptional Lifestyle Location

Rockville enjoys a superb position on Glenamuck Road, placing an abundance of amenities within easy reach.
Residents benefit from convenient access to:
•	Carrickmines Retail Park
•	Foxrock Village
•	Cabinteely Village
•	Stepaside Village
•	Fernhill Park and Gardens
•	Cabinteely Park

The location also offers exceptional educational facilities, including:
•	Our Lady of the Wayside National School
•	Gaelscoil Thaobh na Coille
•	Kilternan Church of Ireland National School
•	Stepaside Educate Together
•	St. Brigid’s National School
•	John Scottus Senior School
•	Rosemont School

Excellent transport links, nearby retail amenities, beautiful parklands and an outstanding selection of schools combine to make this one of South Dublin’s most sought-after residential addresses.
Don’t miss the opportunity to make 14 Rockville your perfect home!

*Note that some photos presented with this advertisement have been digitally staged to show how a room may look if it were furnished.
